verses.text: Now about the money being collected for God's people. Do what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
On the first day of every week, each of you should put aside some money, as much as you can afford. Then there will be no need to collect money when I come.
When I arrive, I will send the people you choose with letters, to take your gift to Jerusalem.
If it seems right for me to go too, they can travel with me.
I will come to you after I go through Macedonia, because I am planning to travel through Macedonia.
I may stay with you for a while, perhaps even for the whole winter. Then you can help me on my way, wherever I go next.
I do not want to see you now just in passing. I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord allows.
But I will stay in Ephesus until the festival of Pentecost,
because a wide door for great work has opened for me, even though many people are against me.
If Timothy comes, make sure he has nothing to fear while he is with you. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
So no one should look down on him. Send him on his way in peace, so that he can come back to me. I am expecting him with the other believers.
Now about our brother Apollos. I strongly urged him to visit you with the other believers. He did not want to go now, but he will go when he has the chance.
Be alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be brave. Be strong.
Do everything in love.
You know that the household of Stephanas were the first believers in Achaia. They have given themselves to serving God's people. Brothers and sisters, I beg you,
follow the lead of people like them, and of everyone who works hard with them.
I was glad when Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arrived. They have made up for your not being here.
They cheered me up, and they cheered you up too. People like this deserve to be honoured.
The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets in their house.
All the brothers and sisters here send you greetings. Greet each other with a holy kiss.
I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand.
If anyone does not love the Lord, let that person be cursed. Come, Lord!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
